about: The old Trillion src product modules that the part 1-5 lanes held back and that now hold nothing: the confidence filter (REA finding F-0566) joins tools/media-composition, the detector chain that uses it. Saved pages (F-0416) is not a group: afd6d606 moved it with saved links (F-0833) into tools/keep-links-i-saved-elsewhere-such while this lane ran. Layout parts (F-0363) is not a group: 9e78ed82 already moved src/layout-parts.mjs and src/layouts.mjs to tools/make-screen-layouts-and-controls/src, where this row's plan found its bytes. Each was checked at the source commit: its imports are its own settings file and, for saved pages, @noble/hashes, which this package already has. Keep, provider_calls and calls are those of move-rows/trillion-tools-src-m-r-round-2.json. The find-the-right-tool helpers that find_tool_for_job used and no lane had moved (src/dead-end-search.mjs, src/tool-choice-keep.mjs, src/tool-choices.mjs) are two tools of their own; tool:repo-explorer, the make-a-tool-from-a-repo half, was already moved by a8585de1.

groups.joins_tool: A second stage behind media-composition's noisy detectors: keep only the plausible events by a per-context model row, and act, ask or abstain by a confidence threshold. media-composition has no confidence rule of its own.
groups.capability: keep only the plausible detections and ask me or hold back instead of acting when confidence is low
keep a search that found no tool as a dead end with how often it was asked, so I see what my Trillion does not cover yet
remember which tools were offered for a job and which one was run, as training pairs, and drop old choices after a set number of days

not_provider_calls.why: placeCacheFolder(env = process.env) reads the cache folder a computer names in its process environment; it is no Worker binding.
